title: A Protocol for the Colony
author: Odile Marchetti
blurb: Kestrel Hartwell, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
